features.name: Carrier
features.text: You can carry up to four willing allies with you when you move.

features.name: Demolish
features.text: **Spend a Hope** to move up to Far range in a straight line and make an attack against all targets within Melee range of the line. Targets you succeed against take **d8+10** physical damage using your Proficiency and are temporarily _Vulnerable._

features.name: Undaunted
features.text: You gain a +2 bonus to all your damage thresholds.
